verses.original: Γνωρίζω δὲ ὑμῖν ἀδελφοί τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ παρελάβετε ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἑστήκατε
verses.transliteration: Gnōrizō de hymin adelphoi to euangelion ho euēngelisamēn hymin ho kai parelabete en hō kai hestēkate
verses.literal: Now brothers I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you which you received and in which you stand firm
verses.literalPt: Eu vos lembro, irmãos, o evangelho que vos anunciei, o qual também recebestes, e no qual estais firmes,

verses.original: δι’ οὗ καὶ σῴζεσθε τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν εἰ κατέχετε ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ εἰκῇ ἐπιστεύσατε
verses.transliteration: di’ hou kai sōzesthe tini logō euēngelisamēn hymin ei katechete ektos ei mē eikē episteusate
verses.literal: By this gospel you are saved if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you Otherwise . . . . . . you have believed in vain
verses.literalPt: e pelo qual sois salvos, se é que o conservais, como vo-lo preguei, salvo se crestes em vão.

verses.original: Παρέδωκα γὰρ ὑμῖν ἐν πρώτοις ὃ καὶ παρέλαβον ὅτι Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν κατὰ τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: Paredōka gar hymin en prōtois ho kai parelabon hoti Christos apethanen hyper tōn hamartiōn hēmōn kata tas graphas
verses.literal: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures
verses.literalPt: Pois eu vos entreguei primeiramente o que também recebi: que Cristo morreu por nossos pecados, segundo as Escrituras, e que foi sepultado,

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ἐτάφη καὶ ὅτι ἐγήγερται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ κατὰ τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: kai hoti etaphē kai hoti egēgertai tē hēmera tē tritē kata tas graphas
verses.literal: that He was buried that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures
verses.literalPt: e que foi ressuscitado ao terceiro dia, segundo as Escrituras,

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ὤφθη Κηφᾷ εἶτα τοῖς δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: kai hoti ōphthē Kēpha eita tois dōdeka
verses.literal: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve
verses.literalPt: e que apareceu a Cefas e então aos doze.

verses.original: ἔπειτα ὤφθη ἐπάνω πεντακοσίοις ἀδελφοῖς ἐφάπαξ ἐξ ὧν οἱ πλείονες μένουσιν ἕως ἄρτι τινὲς δὲ ἐκοιμήθησαν
verses.transliteration: epeita ōphthē epanō pentakosiois adelphois ephapax ex hōn hoi pleiones menousin heōs arti tines de ekoimēthēsan
verses.literal: After that He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once most of whom are still living . . . . . . though some have fallen asleep
verses.literalPt: Depois, apareceu a mais de quinhentos irmãos de uma vez, dos quais a maior parte permanece até agora, mas alguns já dormiram.

verses.original: ἔπειτα ὤφθη Ἰακώβῳ εἶτα τοῖς ἀποστόλοις πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: epeita ōphthē Iakōbō eita tois apostolois pasin
verses.literal: Then He appeared to James then to all the apostles
verses.literalPt: Depois, apareceu a Tiago e, então, a todos os apóstolos;

verses.original: ἔσχατον δὲ πάντων ὡσπερεὶ τῷ ἐκτρώματι ὤφθη κἀμοί
verses.transliteration: eschaton de pantōn hōsperei tō ektrōmati ōphthē kamoi
verses.literal: And last of all He appeared to me also as to one of untimely birth
verses.literalPt: e, por último de todos, apareceu também a mim, como a um abortivo.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι ὁ ἐλάχιστος τῶν ἀποστόλων ὃς οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς καλεῖσθαι ἀπόστολος διότι ἐδίωξα τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egō gar eimi ho elachistos tōn apostolōn hos ouk eimi hikanos kaleisthai apostolos dioti ediōxa tēn ekklēsian tou Theou
verses.literal: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle because I persecuted the church of God
verses.literalPt: Pois eu sou o mínimo dos apóstolos, que não sou digno de ser chamado apóstolo, porque persegui a igreja de Deus;

verses.original: χάριτι δὲ Θεοῦ εἰμι ὅ εἰμι καὶ ἡ χάρις αὐτοῦ ἡ εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ κενὴ ἐγενήθη ἀλλὰ περισσότερον αὐτῶν πάντων ἐκοπίασα οὐκ ἐγὼ δὲ ἀλλὰ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ σὺν ἐμοί
verses.transliteration: chariti de Theou eimi ho eimi kai hē charis autou hē eis eme ou kenē egenēthē alla perissoteron autōn pantōn ekopiasa ouk egō de alla hē charis tou Theou hē syn emoi
verses.literal: But by the grace of God I am what I am and His grace to me was not in vain No I worked harder than all of them yet not I but the grace of God that was with me
verses.literalPt: mas, pela graça de Deus, sou o que sou, e a sua graça, que me foi concedida, não se tornou vã; antes, trabalhei mais abundantemente que todos eles; não eu, contudo, mas a graça de Deus comigo.

verses.original: εἴτε οὖν ἐγὼ εἴτε ἐκεῖνοι οὕτως κηρύσσομεν καὶ οὕτως ἐπιστεύσατε
verses.transliteration: eite oun egō eite ekeinoi houtōs kēryssomen kai houtōs episteusate
verses.literal: Whether then it was I or they this is what we preach and this is what you believed
verses.literalPt: Portanto, seja eu ou sejam eles, assim pregamos, e assim crestes.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς κηρύσσεται ὅτι ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγήγερται πῶς λέγουσιν ἐν ὑμῖν τινες ὅτι ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: Ei de Christos kēryssetai hoti ek nekrōn egēgertai pōs legousin en hymin tines hoti anastasis nekrōn ouk estin
verses.literal: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead
verses.literalPt: Ora, se se prega que Cristo foi ressuscitado dentre os mortos, como dizem alguns dentre vós que não há ressurreição de mortos?

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται
verses.transliteration: ei de anastasis nekrōn ouk estin oude Christos egēgertai
verses.literal: If there is no resurrection of the dead then not even Christ has been raised
verses.literalPt: Mas, se não há ressurreição de mortos, nem Cristo foi ressuscitado;

verses.original: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται κενὸν ἄρα καὶ τὸ κήρυγμα ἡμῶν κενὴ καὶ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ei de Christos ouk egēgertai kenon ara kai to kērygma hēmōn kenē kai hē pistis hymōn
verses.literal: And if Christ has not been raised - our preaching is worthless and so is your faith
verses.literalPt: e, se Cristo não foi ressuscitado, é logo vã a nossa pregação, é também vã a vossa fé.

verses.original: εὑρισκόμεθα δὲ καὶ ψευδομάρτυρες τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἐμαρτυρήσαμεν κατὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἤγειρεν τὸν Χριστόν ὃν οὐκ ἤγειρεν εἴπερ ἄρα νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται
verses.transliteration: heuriskometha de kai pseudomartyres tou Theou hoti emartyrēsamen kata tou Theou hoti ēgeiren ton Christon hon ouk ēgeiren eiper ara nekroi ouk egeirontai
verses.literal: In that case we are also exposed as false witnesses about God For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised
verses.literalPt: Somos conhecidos também por falsas testemunhas de Deus, porque testificamos contra Deus que ele ressuscitou a Cristo, ao qual ele não ressuscitou, se, com efeito, os mortos não são ressuscitados.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται
verses.transliteration: Ei gar nekroi ouk egeirontai oude Christos egēgertai
verses.literal: For if the dead are not raised then not even Christ has been raised
verses.literalPt: Pois, se os mortos não são ressuscitados, nem Cristo foi ressuscitado;

verses.original: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται ματαία ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν ἐστίν ἔτι ἐστὲ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ei de Christos ouk egēgertai mataia hē pistis hymōn estin eti este en tais hamartiais hymōn
verses.literal: And if Christ has not been raised your faith is futile you are still in your sins
verses.literalPt: mas, se Cristo não foi ressuscitado, a vossa fé é vã, e estais ainda em vossos pecados.

verses.original: ἄρα καὶ οἱ κοιμηθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ ἀπώλοντο
verses.transliteration: ara kai hoi koimēthentes en Christō apōlonto
verses.literal: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished
verses.literalPt: Também, por conseguinte, os que dormiram em Cristo pereceram.

verses.original: εἰ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ ταύτῃ ἐν Χριστῷ ἠλπικότες ἐσμὲν μόνον ἐλεεινότεροι πάντων ἀνθρώπων ἐσμέν
verses.transliteration: ei en tē zōē tautē en Christō ēlpikotes esmen monon eleeinoteroi pantōn anthrōpōn esmen
verses.literal: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone we are to be pitied more than all men
verses.literalPt: Se nesta vida temos unicamente esperado em Cristo, somos de todos os homens os mais dignos de lástima.

verses.original: Νυνὶ δὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀπαρχὴ τῶν κεκοιμημένων
verses.transliteration: Nyni de Christos egēgertai ek nekrōn aparchē tōn kekoimēmenōn
verses.literal: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep
verses.literalPt: Mas, agora, Cristo foi ressuscitado dentre os mortos, sendo ele as primícias dos que dormem.

verses.original: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ δι’ ἀνθρώπου θάνατος καὶ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: epeidē gar di’ anthrōpou thanatos kai di’ anthrōpou anastasis nekrōn
verses.literal: For since death came through a man the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man
verses.literalPt: Pois, desde que a morte veio por um homem, também por um homem veio a ressurreição dos mortos.

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐν τῷ Ἀδὰμ πάντες ἀποθνήσκουσιν οὕτως καὶ ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ πάντες ζωοποιηθήσονται
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar en tō Adam pantes apothnēskousin houtōs kai en tō Christō pantes zōopoiēthēsontai
verses.literal: For as in Adam all die so . . . in Christ all will be made alive
verses.literalPt: Pois, assim como em Adão todos morrem, assim também em Cristo todos serão vivificados.

verses.original: Ἕκαστος δὲ ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ τάγματι ἀπαρχὴ Χριστός ἔπειτα οἱ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hekastos de en tō idiō tagmati aparchē Christos epeita hoi tou Christou en tē parousia autou
verses.literal: But each in his own turn Christ the firstfruits then at His coming those who belong to Him
verses.literalPt: Mas cada um na sua ordem. As primícias, Cristo; depois, os que são de Cristo, na sua vinda.

verses.original: εἶτα τὸ τέλος ὅταν παραδιδῷ τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρί ὅταν καταργήσῃ πᾶσαν ἀρχὴν καὶ πᾶσαν ἐξουσίαν καὶ δύναμιν
verses.transliteration: eita to telos hotan paradidō tēn basileian tō Theō kai Patri hotan katargēsē pasan archēn kai pasan exousian kai dynamin
verses.literal: Then the end will come when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion - authority and power
verses.literalPt: Então, virá o fim, quando ele entregar o reino ao Deus e Pai, quando houver destruído todo domínio e toda autoridade e poder.

verses.original: δεῖ γὰρ αὐτὸν βασιλεύειν ἄχρι οὗ θῇ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: dei gar auton basileuein achri hou thē pantas tous echthrous hypo tous podas autou
verses.literal: For He must reign until . . . He has put all His enemies under His feet
verses.literalPt: Pois é necessário que ele reine, até que ponha todos os seus inimigos debaixo dos seus pés.

verses.original: ἔσχατος ἐχθρὸς καταργεῖται ὁ θάνατος
verses.transliteration: eschatos echthros katargeitai ho thanatos
verses.literal: The last enemy to be destroyed is death
verses.literalPt: O último inimigo que será destruído é a morte.

verses.original: Πάντα γὰρ Ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὅταν δὲ εἴπῃ ὅτι πάντα ὑποτέτακται δῆλον ὅτι ἐκτὸς τοῦ ὑποτάξαντος αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα
verses.transliteration: Panta gar Hypetaxen hypo tous podas autou hotan de eipē hoti panta hypotetaktai dēlon hoti ektos tou hypotaxantos autō ta panta
verses.literal: For God has put everything under His feet Now when it says that everything has been put under Him this clearly does not include the One who put everything under . . . . . . Him
verses.literalPt: Porque: Todas as coisas sujeitou debaixo dos pés dele. Mas, quando se diz que todas as coisas lhe estão sujeitas, claro é que se excetua aquele que lhe sujeitou todas as coisas.

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ ὑποταγῇ αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ Υἱὸς ὑποταγήσεται τῷ ὑποτάξαντι αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ἵνα ᾖ ὁ Θεὸς τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: hotan de hypotagē autō ta panta tote kai autos ho Huios hypotagēsetai tō hypotaxanti autō ta panta hina ē ho Theos ta panta en pasin
verses.literal: And when all things have been subjected to Him then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him so that God may be all in all
verses.literalPt: Quando tudo lhe estiver sujeito, então, também o mesmo Filho estará sujeito àquele que lhe sujeitou todas as coisas, para que Deus seja em todas as coisas.

verses.original: Ἐπεὶ τί ποιήσουσιν οἱ βαπτιζόμενοι ὑπὲρ τῶν νεκρῶν εἰ ὅλως νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται τί καὶ βαπτίζονται ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Epei ti poiēsousin hoi baptizomenoi hyper tōn nekrōn ei holōs nekroi ouk egeirontai ti kai baptizontai hyper autōn
verses.literal: If these things are not so what will those do who are baptized for the dead If the dead are not raised at all why are people baptized for them
verses.literalPt: De outra maneira, que farão os que se batizam pelos mortos? Se, realmente, os mortos não são ressuscitados, por que, então, se batizam por eles?

verses.original: τί καὶ ἡμεῖς κινδυνεύομεν πᾶσαν ὥραν
verses.transliteration: ti kai hēmeis kindyneuomen pasan hōran
verses.literal: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour
verses.literalPt: Por que nos expomos também nós a perigos a toda hora?

verses.original: καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀποθνῄσκω νὴ τὴν ὑμετέραν καύχησιν ἀδελφοί ἣν ἔχω ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: kath’ hēmeran apothnēskō nē tēn hymeteran kauchēsin adelphoi hēn echō en Christō Iēsou tō Kyriō hēmōn
verses.literal: I face death every day brothers as surely as - I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord
verses.literalPt: Declaro, irmãos, pelo regozijo que tenho a vosso respeito em Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor, que morro todos os dias.

verses.original: εἰ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ἐθηριομάχησα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ τί μοι τὸ ὄφελος εἰ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται Φάγωμεν καὶ πίωμεν αὔριον γὰρ ἀποθνήσκομεν
verses.transliteration: ei kata anthrōpon ethēriomachēsa en Ephesō ti moi to ophelos ei nekroi ouk egeirontai Phagōmen kai piōmen aurion gar apothnēskomen
verses.literal: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives what did I gain . . . If the dead are not raised Let us eat and drink for tomorrow we die
verses.literalPt: Se eu, como homem, combati com as feras em Éfeso, que me aproveita isso? Se os mortos não são ressuscitados, comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morreremos.

verses.original: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε Φθείρουσιν ἤθη χρηστὰ ὁμιλίαι κακαί
verses.transliteration: Mē planasthe Phtheirousin ēthē chrēsta homiliai kakai
verses.literal: Do not be deceived Bad company corrupts good character
verses.literalPt: Não vos deixeis enganar: más companhias corrompem bons costumes.

verses.original: ἐκνήψατε δικαίως καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε ἀγνωσίαν γὰρ Θεοῦ τινες ἔχουσιν πρὸς ἐντροπὴν ὑμῖν λαλῶ
verses.transliteration: eknēpsate dikaiōs kai mē hamartanete agnōsian gar Theou tines echousin pros entropēn hymin lalō
verses.literal: Sober up as you ought and stop sinning for some of you are ignorant of God I say this to your shame
verses.literalPt: Despertai para a justiça e não pequeis; pois alguns não têm conhecimento de Deus; digo isso para vos envergonhar.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἐρεῖ τις Πῶς ἐγείρονται οἱ νεκροί ποίῳ δὲ σώματι ἔρχονται
verses.transliteration: Alla erei tis Pōs egeirontai hoi nekroi poiō de sōmati erchontai
verses.literal: But someone will ask How are the dead raised With what kind of body will they come
verses.literalPt: Mas alguém dirá: Como são ressuscitados os mortos? E em que qualidade de corpo veem?

verses.original: ἄφρων σὺ ὃ σπείρεις οὐ ζωοποιεῖται ἐὰν μὴ ἀποθάνῃ
verses.transliteration: aphrōn sy ho speireis ou zōopoieitai ean mē apothanē
verses.literal: You fool What you sow does not come to life unless . . . it dies
verses.literalPt: Insensato, o que tu semeias não se vivifica sem que morra;

verses.original: καὶ ὃ σπείρεις οὐ τὸ σῶμα τὸ γενησόμενον σπείρεις ἀλλὰ γυμνὸν κόκκον εἰ τύχοι σίτου ἤ τινος τῶν λοιπῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ho speireis ou to sōma to genēsomenon speireis alla gymnon kokkon ei tychoi sitou ē tinos tōn loipōn
verses.literal: And what you sow is not the body that will be but just a seed perhaps . . . of wheat or something else
verses.literalPt: e o que semeias, não semeias o corpo que há de nascer, mas o mero grão, como, por exemplo, de trigo ou de alguma outra coisa;

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς δίδωσιν αὐτῷ σῶμα καθὼς ἠθέλησεν καὶ ἑκάστῳ τῶν σπερμάτων ἴδιον σῶμα
verses.transliteration: ho de Theos didōsin autō sōma kathōs ēthelēsen kai hekastō tōn spermatōn idion sōma
verses.literal: But God gives it a body as He has designed and to each kind of seed He gives its own body
verses.literalPt: Deus, porém, lhe dá um corpo como lhe aprouve e, a cada uma das sementes, um corpo próprio.

verses.original: Οὐ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἡ αὐτὴ σάρξ ἀλλὰ ἄλλη μὲν ἀνθρώπων ἄλλη δὲ σὰρξ κτηνῶν ἄλλη δὲ σὰρξ πτηνῶν ἄλλη δὲ ἰχθύων
verses.transliteration: Ou pasa sarx hē autē sarx alla allē men anthrōpōn allē de sarx ktēnōn allē de sarx ptēnōn allē de ichthyōn
verses.literal: Not all flesh is the same - Men have one kind of flesh animals have another - birds another and fish another
verses.literalPt: Nem toda carne é a mesma carne, mas uma é a dos homens, outra, a dos animais, outra, a das aves, e outra, a dos peixes.

verses.original: καὶ σώματα ἐπουράνια καὶ σώματα ἐπίγεια ἀλλὰ ἑτέρα μὲν ἡ τῶν ἐπουρανίων δόξα ἑτέρα δὲ ἡ τῶν ἐπιγείων
verses.transliteration: kai sōmata epourania kai sōmata epigeia alla hetera men hē tōn epouraniōn doxa hetera de hē tōn epigeiōn
verses.literal: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another
verses.literalPt: Também há corpos celestes e corpos terrestres; mas uma é a glória dos celestes, e outra, a dos terrestres.

verses.original: ἄλλη δόξα ἡλίου καὶ ἄλλη δόξα σελήνης καὶ ἄλλη δόξα ἀστέρων ἀστὴρ γὰρ ἀστέρος διαφέρει ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: allē doxa hēliou kai allē doxa selēnēs kai allē doxa asterōn astēr gar asteros diapherei en doxē
verses.literal: The sun has one degree of splendor the moon another and the stars another and star differs from star in splendor
verses.literalPt: Uma é a glória do sol, outra, a glória da lua, e outra, a glória das estrelas; porque uma estrela difere de outra em glória.

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ἡ ἀνάστασις τῶν νεκρῶν σπείρεται ἐν φθορᾷ ἐγείρεται ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai hē anastasis tōn nekrōn speiretai en phthora egeiretai en aphtharsia
verses.literal: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead What is sown is perishable it is raised imperishable
verses.literalPt: Assim também é a ressurreição dos mortos. Semeia-se em corrupção, é ressuscitado em incorrupção; semeia-se em vileza, é ressuscitado em glória;

verses.original: σπείρεται ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ ἐγείρεται ἐν δόξῃ σπείρεται ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ ἐγείρεται ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: speiretai en atimia egeiretai en doxē speiretai en astheneia egeiretai en dynamei
verses.literal: It is sown in dishonor it is raised in glory It is sown in weakness it is raised in power
verses.literalPt: semeia-se em fraqueza, é ressuscitado em poder;

verses.original: σπείρεται σῶμα ψυχικόν ἐγείρεται σῶμα πνευματικόν Εἰ ἔστιν σῶμα ψυχικόν ἔστιν καὶ πνευματικόν
verses.transliteration: speiretai sōma psychikon egeiretai sōma pneumatikon Ei estin sōma psychikon estin kai pneumatikon
verses.literal: It is sown a natural body it is raised a spiritual body If there is a natural body there is also a spiritual body
verses.literalPt: semeia-se corpo animal, é ressuscitado corpo espiritual. Se há corpo animal, também o há espiritual.

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ γέγραπται Ἐγένετο ὁ πρῶτος ἄνθρωπος Ἀδὰμ εἰς ψυχὴν ζῶσαν ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀδὰμ εἰς πνεῦμα ζωοποιοῦν
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai gegraptai Egeneto ho prōtos anthrōpos Adam eis psychēn zōsan ho eschatos Adam eis pneuma zōopoioun
verses.literal: So it is written The first man Adam became . . . a living being the last Adam a life-giving spirit
verses.literalPt: Assim está escrito: O primeiro homem, Adão, foi feito em alma vivente; o último Adão, em espírito vivificante.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐ πρῶτον τὸ πνευματικὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ ψυχικόν ἔπειτα τὸ πνευματικόν
verses.transliteration: All’ ou prōton to pneumatikon alla to psychikon epeita to pneumatikon
verses.literal: The spiritual however was not first but the natural and then the spiritual
verses.literalPt: Mas não é primeiro o espiritual, senão o animal; depois, o espiritual.

verses.original: ὁ πρῶτος ἄνθρωπος ἐκ γῆς χοϊκός ὁ δεύτερος ἄνθρωπος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho prōtos anthrōpos ek gēs choikos ho deuteros anthrōpos ex ouranou
verses.literal: The first man was of the dust of the earth the second man from heaven
verses.literalPt: O primeiro homem é da terra, é terreno; o segundo homem é do céu.

verses.original: οἷος ὁ χοϊκός τοιοῦτοι καὶ οἱ χοϊκοί καὶ οἷος ὁ ἐπουράνιος τοιοῦτοι καὶ οἱ ἐπουράνιοι
verses.transliteration: hoios ho choikos toioutoi kai hoi choikoi kai hoios ho epouranios toioutoi kai hoi epouranioi
verses.literal: As was the earthly man so also are those who are of the earth and as is the heavenly man so also are those who are of heaven
verses.literalPt: Qual o terreno, tais também os terrenos; qual o celestial, tais também os celestiais;

verses.original: καὶ καθὼς ἐφορέσαμεν τὴν εἰκόνα τοῦ χοϊκοῦ φορέσομεν καὶ τὴν εἰκόνα τοῦ ἐπουρανίου
verses.transliteration: kai kathōs ephoresamen tēn eikona tou choikou phoresomen kai tēn eikona tou epouraniou
verses.literal: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man
verses.literalPt: e, como trouxemos a imagem do terreno, também traremos a imagem do celestial.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δέ φημι ἀδελφοί ὅτι σὰρξ καὶ αἷμα βασιλείαν Θεοῦ κληρονομῆσαι οὐ δύναται οὐδὲ ἡ φθορὰ τὴν ἀφθαρσίαν κληρονομεῖ
verses.transliteration: Touto de phēmi adelphoi hoti sarx kai haima basileian Theou klēronomēsai ou dynatai oude hē phthora tēn aphtharsian klēronomei
verses.literal: Now I declare to you brothers that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable
verses.literalPt: Ora, digo isto, irmãos, que a carne e o sangue não podem herdar o reino dos céus, nem a corrupção herdar a incorrupção.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ μυστήριον ὑμῖν λέγω πάντες οὐ κοιμηθησόμεθα πάντες δὲ ἀλλαγησόμεθα
verses.transliteration: Idou mystērion hymin legō pantes ou koimēthēsometha pantes de allagēsometha
verses.literal: Listen I tell you a mystery We will not all sleep but we will all be changed
verses.literalPt: Eis que vos digo um mistério: nem todos dormiremos, mas todos seremos mudados,

verses.original: ἐν ἀτόμῳ ἐν ῥιπῇ ὀφθαλμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ σάλπιγγι σαλπίσει γάρ καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐγερθήσονται ἄφθαρτοι καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀλλαγησόμεθα
verses.transliteration: en atomō en rhipē ophthalmou en tē eschatē salpingi salpisei gar kai hoi nekroi egerthēsontai aphthartoi kai hēmeis allagēsometha
verses.literal: in an instant in the twinkling of an eye at the last trumpet For the trumpet will sound the dead will be raised imperishable and we will be changed
verses.literalPt: num momento, num abrir e fechar de olhos, ao som da última trombeta. A trombeta soará, os mortos serão ressuscitados incorruptíveis, e nós seremos mudados.

verses.original: δεῖ γὰρ τὸ φθαρτὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσασθαι ἀφθαρσίαν καὶ τὸ θνητὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσασθαι ἀθανασίαν
verses.transliteration: dei gar to phtharton touto endysasthai aphtharsian kai to thnēton touto endysasthai athanasian
verses.literal: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality
verses.literalPt: Pois é necessário que este corpo corruptível se revista da incorruptibilidade e que este corpo mortal se revista da imortalidade.

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ τὸ φθαρτὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσηται τὴν ἀφθαρσίαν καὶ τὸ θνητὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσηται ἀθανασίαν τότε γενήσεται ὁ λόγος ὁ γεγραμμένος Κατεπόθη ὁ θάνατος εἰς νῖκος
verses.transliteration: Hotan de to phtharton touto endysētai tēn aphtharsian kai to thnēton touto endysētai athanasian tote genēsetai ho logos ho gegrammenos Katepothē ho thanatos eis nikos
verses.literal: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality then the saying that is written will come to pass Death has been swallowed up in victory
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando este corpo corruptível se revestir da incorruptibilidade e este corpo mortal se revestir da imortalidade, então, se cumprirá a palavra que está escrita: Tragada foi a morte na vitória.

verses.original: Ποῦ σου θάνατε τὸ νῖκος ποῦ σου θάνατε τὸ κέντρον
verses.transliteration: Pou sou thanate to nikos pou sou thanate to kentron
verses.literal: Where O Death is your victory Where O Death is your sting
verses.literalPt: Onde está, ó morte, a tua vitória? Onde está, ó morte, o teu aguilhão?

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ κέντρον τοῦ θανάτου ἡ ἁμαρτία ἡ δὲ δύναμις τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ νόμος
verses.transliteration: To de kentron tou thanatou hē hamartia hē de dynamis tēs hamartias ho nomos
verses.literal: The sting of death is sin and the power of sin is the law
verses.literalPt: O aguilhão da morte é o pecado, e a força do pecado é a lei;

verses.original: τῷ δὲ Θεῷ χάρις τῷ διδόντι ἡμῖν τὸ νῖκος διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: tō de Theō charis tō didonti hēmin to nikos dia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: But thanks be to God who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: mas, graças a Deus, que nos dá a vitória por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Ὥστε ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί ἑδραῖοι γίνεσθε ἀμετακίνητοι περισσεύοντες ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ τοῦ Κυρίου πάντοτε εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ κόπος ὑμῶν οὐκ ἔστιν κενὸς ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Hōste adelphoi mou agapētoi hedraioi ginesthe ametakinētoi perisseuontes en tō ergō tou Kyriou pantote eidotes hoti ho kopos hymōn ouk estin kenos en Kyriō
verses.literal: Therefore my beloved brothers be steadfast and immovable Always excel in the work of the Lord because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain
verses.literalPt: Portanto, meus amados irmãos, sede firmes, constantes, aplicando-vos cada vez mais à obra do Senhor, sabendo que o vosso trabalho não é vão no Senhor.
